title: [maintainer] dead-letter queue unbounded, no cleanup or monitoring
description: Permanent delivery failures move .env and .msg to dead/ subdirectory (relay_queue.rs:276-289). No mechanism for: (1) size limit or automatic expiry, (2) alerting when dead-letter dir grows, (3) operator tooling to inspect/analyze stuck messages, (4) metrics export. Solo operator will eventually accumulate GB of orphaned messages with no visibility. Need: queue size limit with log warning, dead-letter metrics, operator CLI tool to list/export dead-letter contents, or TTL-based cleanup.
